Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production RGBA monster animation sprite sheet for our MapleStory Worlds game. Input image1 is the EXISTING MONSTER SHEET to redraw, preserving this monster concept; image2 is the ACTUAL EPISODE4 MONSTER STYLE REFERENCE, style only, do not draw its characters. Redraw image1 in a cohesive classic 2000s MapleStory sprite style matching image2: narrow continuous deep charcoal-brown silhouette (1 logical pixel, selectively 2 in deep shadow), lively clear midtones, warm highlights and cool shadows, 3–4 broad hard color clusters per surface. Colored inner lines, restrained texture. Avoid fuzzy painted/3D gradients, mud or excessive desaturation, heavy black sticker borders, glassy oversized eyes, random detail changes. Keep original object identity, silhouette proportions, number of parts and face personality. Face feels carved/painted into the object, never pasted rectangular sticker-eyes.
DELIVERY: one COMPLETE sprite sheet, exactly SIX COLUMNS × FIVE ROWS =30 frames. Canvas1920×1600, each equal cell320×320, intended downsample to160×160 using same uniform 0.5 scale. Native logical cell160. No text, labels, grid, dividers, background, checkerboard or cast shadow. Genuine transparent RGBA. Do not trim whole sheet. Keep every effect inside its own cell with at least20 physicalpx clear margin. Match existing sprite occupancy in its cell, do NOT enlarge to fill the cell. Common fixed character centerline localx160 and grounded basey224 (logical80,112). NEVER auto-center individual frames based on action FX. Every frame uses same camera, exact body scale/material palette/face dimensions, consistent outlines. Start with first idle sprite as MASTER and derive other frames from this SAME drawing, no independently redesigned poses. Idle has no scale pulse, lateral drift or swaying face. Body may rotate as a rigid object in actions; face and highlights rotate WITH body. Both eyes aligned in local face plane; shared cream/charcoal eye palette, simultaneous blinking.
Rows:1 IDLE6 (almost identical body, blink at frame3 only, closes and returns seamlessly);2 MOVE6 (coherent complete loop with small intentional foot changes and tilt, no body size change);3 ATTACK6 (anticipation1/charge2/windup3/strike4/followthrough5/recover6; rest frame6 matches idle1);4 HIT6 (recoil1→3 then settles4→6, no new large effects or persistent flash);5 DIE6 (tips/collapses progressively, both eyes shut/X consistently). Local accents only at designated attack charge/strike, not on all idle frames. No arbitrary whole-character white flashing or giant aura. Effects should be crisp tiny pixel highlights without blur.

species.ClubSpirit: Subject 도깨비방망이: original elongated honey amber-brown studded wooden club with thin straight handle below and red cloth at neck, face on lower part of chunky head; same six broad wooden knots. Short straight handle, no legs or humanoid. Idle rigid and stable balanced on handle-tip. Move gentle controlled tip-hop/rock. ATTACK2 tiny ivory-gold glint on upper wooden knot and short amber eye twinkle; ATTACK4 clear gold/ivory curved swing trail only, broad head rotates left to almost horizontal with face physically rotating90degrees WITH head, not screen-upright.5 followthrough,6 vertical original. Preserve original elongated club rather than round maraca.
species.MillstoneSpirit: Subject 맷돌깨비: original TWO stacked cool slate-gray millstone discs with muted moss-green patches, single tan vertical wooden peg at upper right, etched angry cream eyes, little dark red mouth on lower disk and small stone feet. Gray stays lively cool-neutral, moss sage-green, not black/muddy. Disc dimensions identical across poses, same peg position attached to top disc. Tiny pale cyan eye glint only ATTACK2; ATTACK4 twists top disc and rushes left with small clean cyan-white crescent and two compact beige dust puffs, no huge haze. Keep center mass and foot baseline stable except deliberate lean. Keep silhouette narrow readable outline matching style reference.
species.MortarSpirit: Subject 절구깨비: original squat celadon/teal mortar with pale cream lip and TWO tiny teal feet, paired cream round surprised eyes and tiny O mouth; ONE honey-brown pestle always rooted in the opening. No extra pestle/arms. Same oval rim and cylindrical body volume in all30frames. Move is gentle hop with deliberately continuous ascent/descent, body not randomly stretching. Attack2 tiny ivory-gold pinpoint at PESTLE TIP, attack3 small windup, attack4 single pestle swings forward left with clean small cream crescent; mortar itself remains solid same size. On hit use facial squint rather than a cloud of stars. Preserve jade and cream identity.
species.OnggiSpirit: Subject 옹기깨비: original squat round REDDISH BROWN Korean earthenware jar with plum-burgundy shadows, warm terracotta midtone and peach-cream narrow oval rim, tiny knob hands and short pottery feet, paired mischievous cream eyes, dark crooked grin and one cream tooth. Same jar proportions and rim shape throughout. Rich classic Maple palette, not deep flat chocolate. Movement waddle from feet while jar core is rigid. Attack2 brief cream-pink eye twinkle and rim sheen only; attack3 draws ONE small pottery shard from rim; attack4 throws toward left with short pale cream-violet release streak, no dismembered hand/duplicate lid. Die alone shatters progressively into a few large readable pottery pieces.
species.JangseungSpirit: Subject 장승깨비: original pale honey/ivory wooden Korean guardian post with broad straw cap, red squared long nose centered between equal cream rectangular eyes with small charcoal pupils, red/blue cheek paint, squared toothy grin, short root feet, pale cream and green zigzag folk paint at bottom. This is a wooden object, no human flesh. Match existing cap width and stump height; simplify thin straw into well-defined grouped tufts with dark-brown silhouette. All30frames keep exact same cap, eyes, nose and tooth sizes. Attack2 very brief warm yellow glint in eyes and on folk-paint zigzag, no permanent yellow eye replacement. Attack4 spits ONE yellow paper talisman left with small curled gold-cream ribbon gust; preserve carved face during the action. Return rest at6.
species.LanternSpirit: Subject 홍등깨비: original small RED-ORANGE glowing Korean lantern with dark brown thin top loop and small lower fitting, warm golden center in stepped color bands, dark vermilion edge ribs, small playful closed curved eyes and mouth, ONE red side tassel on RIGHT attached by tiny gold bead. No new arms/legs. Unlike other sheets, rows1+2 are ONE12FRAME FLYING LOOP, rigid lantern center stays fixed local(160,160) each cell while loop and tassel sway 1–2 logical pixels; exact same lantern diameter and stripe spacing. Flying rest is contented closed eyes. Row3attack1leans/2opens bright amber eye slits with a tiny crisp gold star near front/3winds/4lunges left with a small sweeping flame-shaped golden flicker, no giant fireball/halo/blur/beam/whiteout/duplicate lantern/5followthrough/6rest. Row4 hit6 and row5 die6, same lantern size unless intentionally tilted. Preserve original compact pumpkinlike lantern shape and tiny proportions.
